name: ZeroB AS6 - Water Softener-6000Liters
summary: The ZeroB AS 6 is a fully automatic water softener designed to convert hard water into soft water using premium Purple Resin Media . With a treatment capacity of 6000 LPH , it helps prevent scale buildup, eliminates soap scum, and enhances bathing, washing, and appliance life.
features: Converts hard water into soft water using Purple Resin Media.
6000 LPH high-flow capacity for residential and commercial applications.
Prevents scale formation in pipelines, geysers, and appliances.
Reduces soap scum and improves bathing, washing, and laundry.
Fully automatic programmable regeneration for hassle-free operation.
Durable composite resin vessel with HDPE brine tank.
Compact installation footprint with high softening efficiency.
Converts hard water into soft water using Purple Resin Media .

rows: Composite Filament Wound Resin Vessel & HDPE Brine Tank
